description: Source code implementing a GitLab prompt management system with template loading, rendering, caching, and integration functionalities. Includes classes for prompt templates, managers, cache, and the main prompt management interface integrated with GitLab.

classes.name: GitLabPromptTemplate
classes.description: Represents a prompt template loaded from GitLab, including its content, metadata, and associated parameters.

classes.name: GitLabTemplateManager
classes.description: Manages loading, parsing, rendering, and listing of prompt templates stored as files in a GitLab repository.

classes.name: GitLabPromptManagement
classes.description: Main interface class integrating with GitLab for prompt management, including prompt retrieval, rendering, and hooks.

classes.name: GitLabPromptCache
classes.description: Caches all prompt files from a GitLab repository into memory for quick access and management.

methods.name: str encode_prompt_id(raw_id: str)
methods.description: Converts a raw GitLab path ID into an encoded ID with 'gitlab::' prefix, replacing '/' with '::'.

methods.name: str decode_prompt_id(encoded_id: str)
methods.description: Decodes an encoded prompt ID back into a GitLab path format, replacing '::' with '/'.
